name: trust-lsp
description: truST — IEC 61131-3 Structured Text language support

trust.languageServer.executablePath.title: Language server path
trust.languageServer.executablePath.description: Path to the truST language server executable.

trust.languageServer.trace.title: Language server trace
trust.languageServer.trace.description: Traces the communication between VS Code and the language server

trust.diagnostics.showIecReferences.title: Show IEC references in diagnostics
trust.diagnostics.showIecReferences.description: Append IEC 61131-3 references to diagnostic messages and link to local spec docs when available.

trust.debugAdapter.executablePath.title: Debug adapter path
trust.debugAdapter.executablePath.description: Path to the truST debug adapter executable. Leave empty to use the bundled/default adapter.

trust.debugAdapter.arguments.title: Debug adapter arguments
trust.debugAdapter.arguments.description: Arguments passed to the debug adapter

trust.debugAdapter.environment.title: Debug adapter environment
trust.debugAdapter.environment.description: Environment variables for the debug adapter

trust.runtime.sourceIncludePatterns.title: Runtime source include patterns
trust.runtime.sourceIncludePatterns.description: Glob patterns for Structured Text sources to load in the runtime. Defaults to all Structured Text files in the workspace.

trust.runtime.sourceExcludePatterns.title: Runtime source exclude patterns
trust.runtime.sourceExcludePatterns.description: Glob patterns of Structured Text sources to exclude from the runtime load set.

trust.runtime.mode.title: Runtime mode
trust.runtime.mode.description: Default runtime mode used by the Run target and Live Values when no project target overrides it.

trust.runtime.controlEndpoint.title: Runtime control endpoint
trust.runtime.controlEndpoint.description: Runtime control endpoint override for Live Values (e.g. unix:///tmp/trust-debug.sock). Leave empty to rely on trust-lsp.toml.

trust.runtime.additionalEndpoints.title: Additional runtime endpoints
trust.runtime.additionalEndpoints.description: Additional runtime control endpoints to aggregate in Devices & Connections (e.g. tcp://10.0.0.2:9901). Each is queried for fleet.topology and merged with the primary runtime so a host appears once.

trust.ads.discoveryPorts.title: ADS discovery ports
trust.ads.discoveryPorts.description: Logical ADS ports tested after an ADS device is discovered. Responding ports are shown on the device and in Browse Tags.

trust.runtime.authTokenFallback.title: Runtime auth token fallback
trust.runtime.authTokenFallback.markdownDescription: **Legacy / not recommended.** Plaintext auth token for the runtime control endpoint. Prefer storing tokens securely via the *Set auth token* prompt (kept in the OS secret store, per endpoint). This setting is read only as a fallback.

trust.runtime.setupUrl.title: Runtime setup URL
trust.runtime.setupUrl.description: Optional setup web URL for the selected runtime host.

trust.runtime.useControlEndpoint.title: Use runtime control endpoint
trust.runtime.useControlEndpoint.description: Use the configured runtime control endpoint for inline values.

trust.runtime.showInlineValues.title: Show inline runtime values
trust.runtime.showInlineValues.description: Enable inline values in the editor.

trust.runtime.ignorePragmas.title: Runtime ignore pragmas
trust.runtime.ignorePragmas.description: Top-of-file pragma tokens that exclude a file from runtime loading.

trust.controlStudio.executablePath.title: Control Studio engine path
trust.controlStudio.executablePath.description: Path to the truST Control Studio engine executable (trust-control-studio). Leave empty to use the bundled/default engine.

trust.runtime.executablePath.title: Runtime executable path
trust.runtime.executablePath.description: Path to the truST runtime executable for run, compile, import/export, and connection flows. Leave empty to use the bundled/default runtime.

trust.testRunner.executablePath.title: Test runner path
trust.testRunner.executablePath.description: Path to the truST test runner executable for running Structured Text tests. Leave empty to use the bundled/default test runner.

trust.visual.generateStructuredTextCompa.title: Generate Structured Text companions
trust.visual.generateStructuredTextCompa.description: Automatically generate or update .st companion files when saving .ladder.json, .blockly.json, .sfc.json, or .statechart.json files.

trust.visual.openStructuredTextCompanion.title: Open generated Structured Text companion
trust.visual.openStructuredTextCompanion.description: Open the generated .st companion after creating or importing visual logic files.

trust.visual.openVisualEditorsAutomatica.title: Open visual logic editors automatically
trust.visual.openVisualEditorsAutomatica.description: Automatically open .ladder.json, .statechart.json, .sfc.json, and .blockly.json files with their visual editors.

languageModelTools.name: trust_get_hover
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get hover information for a symbol in Structured Text.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns hover/documentation info for a symbol at a specific position in a Structured Text file. Use this to understand what a variable, function, or type does.

filePath.description: Absolute path or VS Code URI to the .st file

languageModelTools.name: trust_file_read
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read a Structured Text file or a range within it.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reads file contents (optionally a range) from a Structured Text file. Use this to gather context before editing.

languageModelTools.name: trust_read_range
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read a range from a Structured Text file.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reads a specific range from a Structured Text file. Use this to fetch targeted context.

languageModelTools.name: trust_file_write
languageModelTools.userDescription: Write a full file for Structured Text.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Writes the entire file contents for a Structured Text file. Use this to create or replace a file.

save.description: Whether to save the file after writing

languageModelTools.name: trust_apply_edits
languageModelTools.userDescription: Apply text edits to a Structured Text file.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Applies one or more range edits to a Structured Text file. Use this for precise in-place updates.

save.description: Whether to save the file after applying edits

languageModelTools.name: trust_get_diagnostics
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get errors and warnings in a Structured Text file.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns all diagnostic messages (errors and warnings) for a Structured Text file. Use this to find problems in ST code.

languageModelTools.name: trust_get_definition
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find where a symbol is defined.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the location where a symbol (variable, function, type) is defined. Use this to navigate to declarations.

filePath.description: Absolute path or VS Code URI to the .st file

languageModelTools.name: trust_get_declaration
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find where a symbol is declared.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the location where a symbol is declared. Use this to find the original declaration.

filePath.description: Absolute path or VS Code URI to the .st file

languageModelTools.name: trust_get_type_definition
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find the type definition for a symbol.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns the type definition location for a symbol. Use this to resolve aliases and custom types.

languageModelTools.name: trust_get_implementation
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find implementations of a symbol.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns implementation locations for a symbol (for example, methods or interface implementations). Use this to jump to concrete implementations.

languageModelTools.name: trust_get_references
languageModelTools.userDescription: Find references to a symbol.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns all references to a symbol in Structured Text. Use this to see all uses across files.

includeDeclaration.description: Whether to include the declaration in the results.

languageModelTools.name: trust_get_completions
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get completion items at a position.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns completion items at a specific position in a Structured Text file. Use this to discover identifiers, functions, keywords, and snippets available in context.

languageModelTools.name: trust_get_signature_help
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get signature help at a call site.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns signature help (parameter list and active parameter) at a given position. Use this to call functions/FBs correctly.

languageModelTools.name: trust_get_document_symbols
languageModelTools.userDescription: List symbols in a Structured Text file.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns document symbols for a Structured Text file, including ranges and container hierarchy. Use this to navigate the structure of a file.

languageModelTools.name: trust_get_workspace_symbols
languageModelTools.userDescription: Search workspace symbols.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Searches for symbols across the workspace by name. Use this to find functions, types, variables, or FBs when you don't know where they are defined.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

languageModelTools.name: trust_get_rename_edits
languageModelTools.userDescription: Preview rename edits for a symbol.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns a workspace edit preview for renaming a symbol. Use this to see what would change before applying a rename.

languageModelTools.name: trust_get_formatting_edits
languageModelTools.userDescription: Preview formatting edits for a file.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns formatting edits for a Structured Text file without applying them. Use this to preview formatter changes.

languageModelTools.name: trust_get_code_actions
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get code actions for a range.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns available code actions for a given range. Use this to apply quick fixes or refactors.

languageModelTools.name: trust_get_project_info
languageModelTools.userDescription: Run the trust-lsp.projectInfo LSP command.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Executes the trust-lsp.projectInfo command via workspace/executeCommand and returns the response.

arguments.description: Optional arguments array for the command

languageModelTools.name: trust_get_inline_values
languageModelTools.userDescription: Retrieve inline values from the active debug session.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Requests inline values from the active debug session for a frame and range.

frameId.description: Stack frame id from the debug session

languageModelTools.name: trust_lsp_request
languageModelTools.userDescription: Send a raw LSP request and capture the response.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Sends a raw LSP request via the active Structured Text language client. Returns the response payload and optionally captured notifications.

captureNotifications.description: Optional list of notification methods to capture

notificationTimeoutMs.description: Optional timeout to wait for notifications in milliseconds

captureProgress.description: Whether to capture $/progress notifications and attach a workDoneToken

capturePartialResults.description: Whether to attach a partialResultToken and capture $/progress notifications

workDoneToken.description: Optional workDoneToken to attach to params

partialResultToken.description: Optional partialResultToken to attach to params

languageModelTools.name: trust_lsp_notify
languageModelTools.userDescription: Send a raw LSP notification.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Sends a raw LSP notification via the active Structured Text language client.

languageModelTools.name: trust_get_semantic_tokens_full
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get full semantic tokens for a file.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns full semantic token data for a Structured Text file.

languageModelTools.name: trust_get_semantic_tokens_delta
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get semantic token deltas for a file.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns semantic token delta data for a Structured Text file using a previous result id.

languageModelTools.name: trust_get_semantic_tokens_range
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get semantic tokens for a range.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns semantic token data for a specific range in a Structured Text file.

languageModelTools.name: trust_get_inlay_hints
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get inlay hints for a range.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns inlay hints for a specific range in a Structured Text file.

languageModelTools.name: trust_get_linked_editing
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get linked editing ranges at a position.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns linked editing ranges for a symbol at a specific position.

languageModelTools.name: trust_get_document_links
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get document links for a file.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns document links for a Structured Text file.

languageModelTools.name: trust_get_code_lens
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get code lenses for a file.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns code lenses for a Structured Text file.

resolve.description: Whether to resolve code lens commands

languageModelTools.name: trust_get_selection_ranges
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get selection ranges for positions.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns selection ranges for one or more positions in a Structured Text file.

languageModelTools.name: trust_get_on_type_formatting_edits
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get formatting edits for a typed character.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns formatting edits triggered by a specific character at a position.

languageModelTools.name: trust_call_hierarchy_prepare
languageModelTools.userDescription: Prepare a call hierarchy item at a position.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns call hierarchy items for a symbol at a position.

languageModelTools.name: trust_call_hierarchy_incoming
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get incoming calls for a call hierarchy item.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns incoming call hierarchy items for a prepared call hierarchy item.

languageModelTools.name: trust_call_hierarchy_outgoing
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get outgoing calls for a call hierarchy item.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns outgoing call hierarchy items for a prepared call hierarchy item.

languageModelTools.name: trust_type_hierarchy_prepare
languageModelTools.userDescription: Prepare a type hierarchy item at a position.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns type hierarchy items for a symbol at a position.

languageModelTools.name: trust_type_hierarchy_supertypes
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get supertypes for a type hierarchy item.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns supertypes for a prepared type hierarchy item.

languageModelTools.name: trust_type_hierarchy_subtypes
languageModelTools.userDescription: Get subtypes for a type hierarchy item.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns subtypes for a prepared type hierarchy item.

languageModelTools.name: trust_get_workspace_symbols_timed
languageModelTools.userDescription: Search workspace symbols with timing information.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Searches workspace symbols and returns timing metadata for the query.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

languageModelTools.name: trust_workspace_rename_file
languageModelTools.userDescription: Rename or move a file in the workspace.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Renames or moves a file in the workspace and optionally uses a workspace edit.

oldPath.description: Absolute path to the existing file

newPath.description: Absolute path to the new file

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite an existing file at the destination

languageModelTools.name: trust_update_settings
languageModelTools.userDescription: Update a VS Code setting for Structured Text.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Updates a VS Code setting value and waits for diagnostics refresh.

filePath.description: Optional file path/URI to wait for diagnostics refresh; required for workspaceFolder scope

forceRefresh.description: Force a pull-diagnostics request after updating the setting

languageModelTools.name: trust_read_telemetry
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read trust-lsp telemetry or log output.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Reads trust-lsp telemetry/log data from the workspace or a specified file.

filePath.description: Optional absolute path to the telemetry or log file

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return

tail.description: Whether to return the last N entries

languageModelTools.name: trust_debug_start
languageModelTools.userDescription: Start a Structured Text debug session.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Starts the Structured Text debugger. Optionally provide a configuration file path (must contain a CONFIGURATION entry).

filePath.description: Optional absolute path to the CONFIGURATION entry file

languageModelTools.name: trust_debug_attach
languageModelTools.userDescription: Attach the debugger to a running runtime.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Attaches the Structured Text debugger using runtime.toml (runtime.control.endpoint).

languageModelTools.name: trust_debug_reload
languageModelTools.userDescription: Update an active Structured Text simulator session.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Requests an update for the active Structured Text simulator session.

languageModelTools.name: trust_debug_open_io_panel
languageModelTools.userDescription: Open the Structured Text runtime I/O panel.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Opens the Structured Text runtime I/O panel for the active debug session.

languageModelTools.name: trust_debug_ensure_configuration
languageModelTools.userDescription: Create or select a Structured Text debug configuration entry file.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Ensures a CONFIGURATION entry file exists and can be selected for debugging.

languageModelTools.name: hmi_get_context
languageModelTools.userDescription: Inspect the HMI project screen, current page revisions, compiled equipment variables and library metadata before designing. Read-only. Unsaved ST is explicitly refused until supported.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read the connected project using saved files and unsaved editor buffers. Returns typed variables, page metadata, current editor selection, revisions and provenance. Compilation failures are explicitly partial, never an empty usable program. No runtime or source mutation.

workspaceId.description: ID returned by context or workspace-selection error. May be omitted with one open workspace.

languageModelTools.name: hmi_browse_library
languageModelTools.userDescription: Browse HMI components with visual contact sheets and typed binding information. Discover compositionPatterns with an empty query; query an exact pattern ID (process-overview, equipment-detail, multi-unit, investigation, settings) for its synthetic image and normal builder reference model. Replace Example paths with inspected project bindings; reference images are not visual approval or deployable drafts.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Search real HMI components and receive labelled PNG contact sheets plus their binding requirements, ports and default sizes. Synthetic design samples only. Defaults to 12 definitions; follow nextCursor for more. Any unpictured custom components are listed explicitly. Inspect the images before choosing components. Discover compositionPatterns with an empty query; query an exact pattern ID (process-overview, equipment-detail, multi-unit, investigation, settings) for its synthetic image and normal builder reference model. Replace Example paths with inspected project bindings; reference images are not visual approval or deployable drafts.

workspaceId.description: ID returned by context or workspace-selection error. May be omitted with one open workspace.

state.description: Synthetic component state to render; unsupported objects are explicitly listed.

languageModelTools.name: hmi_inspect_page
languageModelTools.userDescription: Read a current HMI page including unsaved editor text. Inspect all objects or selected IDs, their pipes and connected neighbours. Read-only; use before proposing changes.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Read a current HMI page including unsaved editor text. Inspect all objects or selected IDs, their pipes and connected neighbours. Read-only; use before proposing changes.

workspaceId.description: ID returned by context or workspace-selection error. May be omitted with one open workspace.

file.description: Project-relative hmi/pages, hmi/popups or hmi/panels TOML path

region.description: Inspect the rotated design boxes overlapping this rectangle. Use region or ids, never both.

languageModelTools.name: hmi_compose_page
languageModelTools.userDescription: Compose an isolated editable page proposal from catalogue components and supplied bindings. Does not modify source files. Render, inspect and validate the result before application.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Compose an isolated editable page proposal from catalogue components and supplied bindings. Does not modify source files. Render, inspect and validate the result before application. Each item has id/type, optional region and bind map. Example: {"id":"tank","type":"tank","region":"process","min":0,"max":3,"bind":{"level":{"path":"Main.Level","direction":"read"}}}. No source file is changed. To refine an existing page, call with only file and sourceFile set to that page path, then use hmi_edit_draft. Its unsaved customer edits are the baseline and remain untouched until application.

bind.description: Map component properties to typed bindings. Example: {"level":{"path":"Main.Level","direction":"read"}}. Use bind, not bindings; path, not source.

path.description: Exact PLC path returned by hmi_get_context, e.g. Main.Level.

pinnedAt.description: Keep this object at its supplied position and size. Other objects avoid it; coordinates are on the 8-pixel grid.

sourceFile.description: Existing project-relative HMI page to copy into a draft, including its unsaved text. Set file to the same path to refine it, or a new path to duplicate it.

key.description: Unique creation request key. Reuse it only when retrying the same proposal; use a new key for a new proposal.

layout.description: Explicit design regions, spacing and fill order. Regions must fit below the heading within page margins and may not overlap. Impossible constraints fail instead of shrinking content.

operatorTask.description: The operator task this screen should support; shown with its provenance in proposal review.

rationale.description: Explain the proposed hierarchy and layout choices.

assumptions.description: Explicit assumptions for the customer to review; never invent process connectivity.

languageModelTools.name: hmi_edit_draft
languageModelTools.userDescription: Apply semantic edits to an isolated draft, preserving unrelated objects. Requires its current revision and a unique request key. Never changes project files.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Apply semantic edits to an isolated draft, preserving unrelated objects. Requires its current revision and a unique request key. Never changes project files. Operations have explicit schemas. To shorten a label use {"op":"update","id":"reading","properties":{"label":"Temp."}}; to widen a card use {"op":"resize","id":"reading","size":[280,64]}. Reuse the same key only to retry the exact same request.

oneOf.description: Change properties: {"op":"update","id":"temperature","properties":{"label":"Temp."}}. Use properties, not changes.
Add one catalogue object at an explicit position.

bind.description: Map component properties to typed bindings. Example: {"level":{"path":"Main.Level","direction":"read"}}. Use bind, not bindings; path, not source.

oneOf.description: Clone objects and their internal pipes with new unique IDs.

oneOf.description: Remove a named binding; validation will report unresolved displays.

allowUnresolved.description: Keep unresolved process-first bindings in the private draft. Validation still reports errors and normal apply remains disabled.

languageModelTools.name: hmi_validate_draft
languageModelTools.userDescription: Check native file format and PLC bindings plus current visual warnings. A valid binding result does not establish good visual design.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Check native file format and PLC bindings plus current visual warnings. A valid binding result does not establish good visual design.

viewports.description: Available HMI content areas, excluding editor/browser chrome. Fit-scale geometry is a review aid, not physical-panel proof.

proposeProgram.description: Return separate native PLC edit proposals without applying them. Recompile and create a fresh HMI proposal after accepting PLC edits.

languageModelTools.name: hmi_render_draft
languageModelTools.userDescription: Return a real PNG of the exact draft revision using the shared HMI drawing, plus object bounds. Synthetic design values only. Inspect the image before accepting the page.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Return a real PNG of the exact draft revision using the shared HMI drawing, plus object bounds. Synthetic design values only. Inspect the image before accepting the page.

crop.description: Optional native-pixel detail, returned with the whole page. Select existing object IDs or an in-page rectangle.

language.description: A language tag declared by the project; translations use unsaved editor text.

languageModelTools.name: hmi_preview_states
languageModelTools.userDescription: Return synthetic images for selected states such as sample, stale and unknown. No equipment commands. Unsupported object states are listed explicitly.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Render labelled synthetic preview states without runtime writes. Explicit mode simulator requires a named, user-connected local simulator session and matching deployed draft pages; it may send the supplied bounded HMI commands with actual outcomes and readback. Never starts, deploys, falls back to, or writes a physical target.

language.description: A language tag declared by the project; translations use unsaved editor text.

languageModelTools.userDescription: Review, apply or discard a named draft. Engineering validation is required before applying. Deployment and equipment operation are separate.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Review, apply or discard a named draft. Engineering validation is required before applying. Deployment and equipment operation are separate.

allowIncomplete.description: Explicitly apply a design marked incomplete. Native bundle validation rejects deployment until the marker is cleared and checks pass.

explore.description: Include an interactive, network-free synthetic navigation preview in the review. Commands and login remain disabled.
